newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African police arrest 27 for stealing gold.
newsitem.headline: S.African police arrest 27 for stealing gold.

text.p: South African police arrested 27 workers on Monday for stealing pure gold worth about 300,000 rand ($66,000) at three gold processing plants in Welkom, a mining town south of Johannesburg.
"We've still got another 58 identified suspects and we are targetting to arrest all of them," a spokesman, Senior Superintendent Derek van Wyk, said.
The country's Chamber of Mines estimates that at least 30 tonnes of pure gold worth 1.58 billion rand ($348 million) is smuggled out of mines every year.
